correctness.rationale: Let S and E be the numbers of surviving vertices and edges, and Z the indicator that all cycle vertices survive. The surviving induced graph has cycle rank Z, including on the empty outcome, so K=S−E+Z and the mean follows from the host having n edges. In Var(E), only pairs sharing one vertex contribute off-diagonal terms, adding 2W p³(1−p) to n(p²−p⁴); Cov(S,E)=2n p²(1−p). For cycle covariance, each cycle vertex contributes p^ℓ(1−p) to Cov(S,Z). An edge on the cycle contributes p^ℓ(1−p²) to Cov(E,Z), and a cycle-to-off-cycle edge contributes p^(ℓ+1)(1−p). Every other edge is independent of Z; in particular a chord cannot exist. Subtraction gives Cov(S−E,Z)=−(ℓ+h)p^(ℓ+1)(1−p). Together with Var(Z) this proves the stated variance and sign, including zero variance at p=0,1. For n≤5, any possible h disagreement requires a triangle and two noncycle vertices; the one-attachment pendant chain has one leaf, while the two-attachment alternatives each have two leaves. For the displayed six-vertex pair the cycles are 345 and 124, and h=1 and 2 respectively at identical degrees. An independent union-find enumeration found labeled counts 1, 15, 222, 3,660 by order, and verified both raw moment polynomials by grouping retained subsets by size (7,796 exact equalities). Direct half-retention variances of the pair were 31/64 and 27/64. The proof, not the census, establishes the all-order law.
residual_risks: The result is unconditional and assumes homogeneous independent vertex retention on a simple unicyclic host. No heterogeneous, correlated, multicyclic or ecological inference follows.

originality.rationale: General induced-component laws and the tree variance mechanism are existing coverage. The distinct result supported here is the reduction of unicyclic variance to the attachment count after degree and cycle-length matching, including strict all-p ranking and the sharp minimum pair. This is an exact structural comparison, not a new general procedure to compute the component law or a historical priority certification.
residual_risks: Full comparison with the cactus record is limited by exact mirror availability. The search did not exhaust older graph-reliability or percolation work. The general computability of the moments is not new.

value.rationale: When mean fragmentation and degree inventory agree, knowing the number of branches incident to the cycle is sufficient to order fluctuations strictly at every nondegenerate survival probability. This is a structural invariance and identifiability statement useful for comparing small redundant networks, not just two evaluated graphs. The six-vertex minimum identifies exactly when that distinction can first arise.
residual_risks: The value is mathematical: component count is a snapshot statistic, not evidence about colonization, persistence, or actual ecological risk.
